newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK 120 mln 42-day T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK 120 mln 42-day T-bills.

text.p: Croatia's finance ministry said on Tuesday it raised 120 million kuna through 42-day treasury bills at a rate of 10.9 percent, down from 11 percent two weeks ago.
The issue was priced at 98,761 kuna.
The ministry had offered 100 million kuna, but raised another 20 million due to strong demand totalling 155.9 million.
Some 94.5 percent of the bidders came from the banking sector, the ministry said in a statement.
The weighted average was 10.77 percent. The bills are payable in two days and they mature on March 6.
Croatia will next auction 40 million kuna worth of 91-day bills on January 28.
